# Spec Review Checklist: Result, Restart & Final Validation

**Purpose**: Author self-review of requirement quality before proceeding to /speckit-plan — validates completeness, clarity, consistency, and coverage across all spec dimensions.
**Created**: 2026-06-03
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command. Items test the *requirements themselves* for quality, not the implementation.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Are requirements defined for *both* round-end triggers (timer expiry and all-correct guess)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, FR-002] — Both FR-001 and FR-002 explicitly defined.
- [x] CHK002 - Is there a requirement covering what the server does with the round timer when all guessers guess correctly before it expires? [Completeness, Gap] — FR-002: transitions immediately without waiting for timer. Covered by gameplay interaction feature's `checkRoundExpiry` pattern (pre-existing).
- [x] CHK003 - Are requirements defined for every data element shown on the results screen (correct word, scores, guess history, player names)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003–FR-005] — FR-003 (word), FR-004 (cumulative scores), FR-005 (guess history). Player names are participants already in the snapshot.
- [x] CHK004 - Is there a requirement covering how accumulated scores are updated when a round ends (i.e., when are per-round points added to the cumulative total)? [Completeness, Gap] — Scoring rules are owned by the gameplay interaction spec (upstream dependency; noted in Assumptions). FR-009 covers preservation.
- [x] CHK005 - Are requirements defined for what the drawer sees on the results screen vs. what guessers see, or is the results screen identical for all roles? [Completeness, Gap] — Clarified: same screen for all roles. Recorded in Clarifications section.
- [x] CHK006 - Are requirements defined for the lobby screen content after restart (e.g., does the lobby show cumulative scores, just player names, or both)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, FR-009] — FR-014 added: lobby MUST show cumulative scores alongside player names. T017 added to tasks.

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 - Is "all round-specific state" (FR-010) explicitly enumerated rather than left as an open set? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010] — FR-010 enumerates: drawn word, guess history, active timer, drawer assignment. Explicitly notes `roundDurationSeconds` is NOT cleared (fixed constant).
- [x] CHK008 - Is "players preserved" (FR-008) precisely defined — does it mean only name and participantId, or also role (drawer/guesser assignment)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008] — FR-010 clears drawer assignment; FR-008 preserves player identities and names. Role is a per-round assignment, not a persistent player property.
- [x] CHK009 - Is the meaning of "cumulative total score" unambiguous — does it include the just-completed round's points, or only prior rounds? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications] — Clarifications: "running total across all rounds, not a per-round delta." Includes the just-completed round.
- [x] CHK010 - Is "full guess history" (FR-005) defined with enough specificity — are per-guess timestamps required, or only ordering by submission sequence? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005] — Ordering is by submission sequence (insertion order, append-only array). Documented in research.md. Timestamps exist in the model but are not a display requirement.
- [x] CHK011 - Is "No guesses were made" placeholder requirement specified with enough detail — is it a single line of text, a distinct UI region, or an inline message within the history section? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Clarifications] — FR-005 + Clarifications: "No guesses were made" placeholder message in the history section (inline, same region as guess list). T006 implements as a text node within the existing Card component.
- [x] CHK012 - Is the term "host" consistently defined across spec sections, and does FR-006/FR-013 reference the same host identity established in the Assumptions? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions] — Assumptions: "host is the participant who created the room." Used consistently in FR-006, FR-013, and all plan/tasks references.

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK013 - Are FR-006 (Play Again visible only to host) and FR-013 (non-hosts cannot trigger restart) consistent and non-redundant — does one supersede the other? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, FR-013] — Complementary (UI gate + server gate), not redundant. Analysis finding D1 noted this as harmless. Both retained for defence-in-depth.
- [x] CHK014 - Are SC-001 and SC-003 (≤ 2 seconds) consistent with the polling interval assumption in the Assumptions section? [Consistency, Spec §SC-001, SC-003, Assumptions] — Assumptions state polling interval ≤2s. SC-001 and SC-003 are each "within one polling cycle (≤ 2 seconds)." Fully consistent.
- [x] CHK015 - Does the edge case "host triggers restart while some clients have not yet polled result state" conflict with any functional requirement, or is it explicitly deferred? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases] — No conflict: clients that haven't polled yet will get the new lobby state on their next poll. FR-012 covers this. Deferred scenario is benign.
- [x] CHK016 - Are the "Round Result" and "Player" key entities consistent with how FR-004 and FR-009 describe score accumulation? [Consistency, Spec §Key Entities, FR-004, FR-009] — "Player" entity: "accumulated score across rounds, survives restarts." FR-004: cumulative total. FR-009: preserved on restart. Consistent.

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK017 - Is SC-002 ("100% of guesses in correct order") objectively verifiable without knowing the implementation — is there a defined source of truth for ordering? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002] — Source of truth: insertion order of the `guesses` array (append-only). T004 asserts this. Clarified in research.md.
- [x] CHK018 - Is SC-004 ("zero players dropped") measurable for the edge case where a player voluntarily disconnects before restart — is that counted as "dropped"? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004] — Voluntary disconnects are out of scope (no heartbeat/presence mechanism per constitution). SC-004 applies to players in `room.participants` at the time of restart.
- [x] CHK019 - Is SC-005 ("100% score accuracy across restarts") verifiable — is there a defined mechanism or test oracle for comparing pre- and post-restart scores? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005] — Test oracle: T004/T005 unit tests assert scores before and after restart are equal. Manual T014 criterion (7) verifies in E2E.
- [x] CHK020 - Does each functional requirement (FR-001–FR-013) have a corresponding acceptance scenario or success criterion it maps to? [Traceability, Gap] — Full traceability table in speckit-analyze coverage summary confirms all FRs mapped. FR-014 added post-analysis, covered by T017 and T014 criterion (7).

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK021 - Are requirements defined for the scenario where a round ends with only one player in the room (edge: single-player game)? [Coverage, Edge Case] — Edge case: `LobbyPage` already requires ≥2 players to start (enforced in UI). A single-player room cannot reach the result state via normal flow. Out of scope.
- [x] CHK022 - Are requirements defined for what happens if a player joins the room exactly as the round ends and the phase transitions to result? [Coverage, Spec §Assumptions] — Assumption: new joiners during result phase are placed in lobby for next round; they do not see in-progress results. Covered in spec Assumptions.
- [x] CHK023 - Is the recovery path specified if the host disconnects permanently during the result phase — does the game stall, auto-restart, or promote a new host? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Assumptions] — Assumption: restart button becomes inaccessible if host disconnects; re-assignment out of scope. Explicitly documented.
- [x] CHK024 - Are requirements defined for rapid successive restarts (host presses Play Again multiple times quickly) — is there a guard against duplicate state resets? [Coverage, Edge Case] — Clarified: backend 409 guard handles it (second call arrives when room is already "lobby"). No additional UI guard required.

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK025 - Are there requirements covering the result screen's behaviour when the room state polling response is delayed beyond the 2-second interval? [Coverage, Non-Functional, Gap] — Clarified: out of scope. Existing silent-retry polling behaviour applies (same as all other screens).
- [x] CHK026 - Is there a requirement specifying the maximum size or age of guess history that must be retained — is there a cap for very long rounds? [Non-Functional, Gap] — No cap required: round duration is fixed at 60 seconds; word list is 5 fixed words. Maximum guess volume is bounded by session and negligible for in-memory storage.
- [x] CHK027 - Are accessibility requirements defined for the results screen (e.g., are scores and guess history readable by screen readers)? [Non-Functional, Gap] — Clarified: out of scope for this project per constitution constraints.

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK028 - Is the dependency on the gameplay interaction feature's scoring rules explicitly referenced — does this spec name the upstream spec it relies on? [Dependencies, Spec §Assumptions] — Assumptions last line: "Score earning rules...are already defined by the gameplay interaction feature and are not re-specified here."
- [x] CHK029 - Is the assumption that "host identity is not re-assigned on disconnect" validated against the room setup spec, or is it potentially in conflict? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions] — Consistent with room setup feature: `hostId` is set at room creation and never mutated. No re-assignment logic exists anywhere in the codebase.
- [x] CHK030 - Is the assumption about word selection after restart ("follows the same rules as initial game start") traceable to a defined rule in another spec, or does it need to be re-stated here? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions] — research.md Decision 6: `startGame` uses `STARTER_WORDS[0]` after restart. Fixed seed per constitution. Acceptable for project scope.
